scriptLines: bronzeConstructors derive(constructorId = iif(isNull(constructorId) || trim(constructorId) == '' || upper(trim(constructorId)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(constructorId)) == 'N/A' || trim(constructorId) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(constructorId)),

constructorRef = iif(isNull(constructorRef) || trim(constructorRef) == '' || upper(trim(constructorRef)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(constructorRef)) == 'N/A' || trim(constructorRef) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(constructorRef)),
name = iif(isNull(name) || trim(name) == '' || upper(trim(name)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(name)) == 'N/A' || trim(name) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(name)),

nationality = iif(isNull(nationality) || trim(nationality) == '' || upper(trim(nationality)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(nationality)) == 'N/A' || trim(nationality) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(nationality))) ~> limpiarTodo

decodificarHtml derive(constructor_name = iif(nombreTmp == lower(nombreTmp) || (nombreTmp == upper(nombreTmp) && length(nombreTmp) > 5), replace(initCap(lower(replace(nombreTmp, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), nombreTmp),

nationality = case(isNull(nationality), 'Unknown', (nationality == lower(nationality) || nationality == upper(nationality)), replace(initCap(lower(replace(nationality, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), nationality)) ~> normalizarTextos
